subject: Vendor activation hold: outstanding insurance evidence and PO conditions
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@brookline.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — insurance + PO checklist

Hi Alex —

Quick follow-up from procurement: we're missing a primary certificate of insurance showing commercial general liability (CGL) with limits of at least $2M aggregate and the Redwood Inference name added as an additional insured. Without that endorsement we can't finalize the PO or enable billing in our system.

Can you either: (A) upload a COI with the additional-insured endorsement, or (B) confirm a timeline for when your broker can issue it? If you already submitted something, please attach it here — our intake system sometimes drops the endorsement line.

Separately, please include a completed W-9 so AP can process the supplier record. I'm copying Neha (procurement lead) and Dev (legal intake) so we can triage any exceptions.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Vendor Onboarding Coordinator
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: onboarding-forms-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@brookline.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@brookline.ai
Date: 2027-04-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — insurance + PO checklist

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the heads up. Attaching the COI and W-9 we just pulled from our broker and our finance team. The COI includes general liability at $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; our broker tells us an additional-insured endorsement is a separate endorsement and requires 5–7 business days to issue.

We have a couple of questions before you escalate: is Redwood able to accept the current COI for a provisional PO while the endorsement is processed? If so, can you confirm any conditional language that needs to appear on the PO? If not, please let us know the exact endorsement language Redwood requires so we can request it from our carrier.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Head of Partnerships — Brookline Analytics
alex.mercer@brookline.ai

Attachments: Brookline_COI_2027.pdf (PDF), Brookline_W9.pdf (PDF)

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: New vendor setup — insurance + PO checklist

Forwarding Brookline's submission — COI shows limits but no endorsement. Dev / Legal: can Redwood accept a conditional PO that explicitly requires issuance of the endorsement within 10 business days of PO execution? Proposed conditional clause (drafted for PO team):

- "This Purchase Order is conditional upon Supplier providing, within ten (10) business days of PO issuance, an Additional Insured Endorsement to the Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured for Commercial General Liability covering the performance under this PO. Failure to provide the endorsement will be grounds for immediate suspension of services and revocation of this PO."

If Legal signs off, procurement can provisionally create the supplier record and queue a conditional PO. If Legal needs stronger language or a different timeline, flag here.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: PO-conditional-terms-Redwood-2027.docx (DOCX)

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: New vendor setup — insurance + PO checklist

Neha —

Thanks, this looks reasonable as a conditional acceptance. Two quick legal notes: (1) change "ten (10) business days" to "ten (10) calendar days" — we prefer calendar days in PO workflows to reduce ambiguity; (2) add a requirement that the endorsement include waiver of subrogation to the extent permitted by law (standard ask). Suggested revised clause below:

- "This Purchase Order is conditional upon Supplier providing, within ten (10) calendar days of PO issuance, an Additional Insured Endorsement to the Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured for Commercial General Liability covering the performance under this PO, and a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc. Failure to provide such endorsement and waiver will be grounds for immediate suspension of services and revocation of this PO."

If procurement is comfortable with calendar days and the added waiver language, proceed. Also note: if Brookline's broker cannot issue the endorsement in that timeframe, request a letter from the broker confirming the expected issuance date and the policy number so we can track it.

-Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@brookline.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — insurance + PO checklist

Hi team —

Appreciate the clear guidance. Our broker confirms they can issue the Additional Insured Endorsement and waiver of subrogation, but it will take 6 calendar days. They also offered an interim confirmation letter that includes the policy number and a promise-to-endorse note for Redwood. I've attached the broker letter — it contains the policy number and expected endorsement date.

Request: can Redwood issue a provisional PO with the conditional clause Dev drafted, and note in the PO that final activation (billing enabled) is contingent on receipt of the endorsement? That will let our teams start integration work while we wait on the formal endorsement.

If you want to route the broker letter to insurance@redwoodinference.com for verification, let us know and we'll copy them.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: broker-confirmation-letter.pdf (PDF), endorsement-request-sample.pdf (PDF)
